title: Corpse Flower
body:
"Corpse flowers are rare and foul-smelling plants that bloom infrequently."

Description

The corpse flower glows a faint green and is fairly large. This flower can be found at the highest peak around the altar in the Acidlands. It temporarily can be found in the Grimestone cave in Mike's Mines. This flower out of every rare flower has the slowest respawn time and grows in the least abundance. Used to craft the Petalfall. It can be sold to Jer Junkman for 250$ per Corpse Flower. It can be turned into Dye by using a Press Machine.

When put into a Composter, the fill level increases by ~27.46% per flower.

Also seems to be based off the Rafflesia plant
